boundary: tenant ownership on a record read
scope: Synthetic owned lab; session and requested IDs are controlled, but record ownership is not documented.
hypothesis: Tenant A may be able to read another tenant's record by guessing its ID.

artifacts.observation: Tenant A's own record request returns HTTP 200 with its expected data.
A request with a guessed different ID returns HTTP 200.
The E2 response body is an empty error envelope and contains no other tenant's value or metadata.
No source establishes who owns the guessed ID or whether it exists.
